h:
欢迎来到我的第一个个人工作流程！

这是一个非常简单的工作流程，具有最佳的“入门”设置以获得漂亮的结果。

我使用 Efficiency Nodes 和 Ultimate SD Upscale 节点来减少节点总数并尽可能优化工作流程。

您唯一需要更改的是前两个节点的选项。这基本上是舒适的 A1111，因为您在几个节点中选择了完全相同的选项。

其余的设置已经为您准备好了，因此您只需选择基础+提示即可。

玩得开心，如果您喜欢我的工作流程，请不要忘记留下评论！

附：
如果您没有更好的高档流程所需的 TIleE 模型，您可以从这里获取 -https://civitai.com/models/38784/controlnet-11-models.

o.en:
Welcome to my first personal workflow!

This is a very simple workflow with best "get-go" settings to get beautiful results.

I'm using Efficiency Nodes and Ultimate SD Upscale nodes to reduce the total number of nodes and optimize the workflow as much as possible.

The only thing you'd need to change are options from first two nodes. This is basically A1111 in comfy, because you're choosing the very same options in just a couple of nodes.

The rest of the settings are already there for you, so you only need to choose basics + prompt.

Have fun, and don't forget to leave a review if you like my workflow!

P.S.
If you don't have TIleE model that is required for a better upscale process, you can get it from here -https://civitai.com/models/38784/controlnet-11-models.
